description: Reverse-ETL sink — batch-POST rows to Braze via the REST API. Supports two source shapes (upstream_asset_key OR inline source:) and two endpoints (users_track for user attribute sync, catalogs for custom catalog item upsert). Auth via a shared BrazeResource (recommended) or inline api_key + endpoint.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key. Shapes: {kind: sql, resource_key|database_url_env_var, query} | {kind: csv, path, read_csv_kwargs} | {kind: inline, rows}.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: BrazeResourceComponent key (recommended). Mutually exclusive with inline api_key_env_var + rest_endpoint.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Inline fallback: env var holding the Braze REST API key. Only used when resource_key is unset.

rest_endpoint.label: REST Endpoint URL
rest_endpoint.description: Inline fallback: region-specific Braze REST URL. Only used when resource_key is unset.

endpoint.description: Which Braze endpoint to POST to.
endpoint.label: Endpoint

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Explicit source_col -> braze_field mapping. Renames columns inline.

user_id_column.description: For endpoint='users_track': column holding the user's primary identifier. Set to `None` for secondary-identifier-only mode (rows identified by `email` or `phone` alone via fields_map).
user_id_column.label: User ID Column

attribute_columns.description: For endpoint='users_track' (legacy pass-through mode when fields_map isn't set): which columns become top-level user attributes. Default: all columns except user_id_column and custom_attribute_columns.
attribute_columns.label: Attribute Columns

custom_attribute_columns.description: For endpoint='users_track': columns to send nested under 'custom_attributes' on the user's Braze profile.
custom_attribute_columns.label: Custom Attribute Columns

item_id_column.description: For endpoint='catalogs': column holding each catalog item's unique id.
item_id_column.label: Item ID Column (catalogs mode)

batch_size.description: Rows per HTTP request. Default = 75 for users_track / 50 for catalogs (Braze's maxima). Lower values reduce rate-limit pressure.
batch_size.label: Batch Size

request_timeout_seconds.description: Per-request HTTP timeout (only used with inline auth path).
request_timeout_seconds.label: Request Timeout Seconds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale. Defines a FreshnessPolicy.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays at 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

name: Braze Sink
